caption: Florence rising from the floor at her concert. We only waited in line for ~an hour before doors open and got to be within like, 2 rows of the front. Bomber concert, big fan of when she told the guy in front of us to stop filming and he didn't understand at first.

And CMAT opened! What a deal. Most involved crowd for an opener I've been in. Bummer they didn't walk down the catwalk at all. Also a bummer they only played for ~30 minutes. Phenomenal regardless, Running/Planning was the highlight.

That's the Texas state capitol building. You CAN get to the top, but apparently only on scheduled tours (lame). I like the one portrait inside with all the governors that's labelled President. Also waiting for the law to find me after accidentally taking a picture of the state congressional floor.

A BBQ place! Super heavy, super tasty even though I only had sides. Banana pudding was the best I've had. 500mL of Coke is too much. So many birds tried to steal our food. We got cornbread to go and planned on eating it at the Florence concert but it turns out that you can't bring cornbread wrapped in plastic in your pocket into a concert venue.

An overpass on the riverwalk where some kayakers lined up really well with the bridge. We did the whole riverwalk then I fell in trying to look at some turtles. Whoever starts a kayak/paddleboard business where you can start by Barton Springs and drop off back near downtown is going to make a killing.
That's the Waterline building in the middle. Saw someone on Reddit talking about it. That's all I got. Isn't Austin so green?
That's a hotel sign. I liked how colorful it was. Brendan was trying on pants, I think, so I wandered around.

That's a building with a tree growing near it. I walked around it for a bit and got kind of lost. Had to take an elevator down one floor 'cause I couldn't find stairs, which was kind of embarrassing. I think this might actually be the Magdalena Hotel.
A fun little truck for a different hotel. I liked this little stretch of Austin. Also, scooters make it pretty easy to move around.
